# Team Billing — Work Breakdown

## Scope Statement
Team Billing subsystem for the B2B SaaS product, covering charge calculation, payment-method storage, invoice generation, usage tracking, and administrative visibility into billing. **All monetary calculation, storage, and display in this release is single-currency (USD) only.**

## Out of Scope (this quarter)
**Multi-currency support** — deferred to a later release per leadership decision. No piece below includes currency conversion, multi-currency storage, or locale-based currency display. *(Flagging this here since it hadn't been written down anywhere — worth confirming this note matches leadership's actual decision before the team starts building against it.)*

---

## 1.0 Team Billing Subsystem

### 1.1 Billing Engine
**Definition:** Calculates charges owed by a customer based on subscription plan, usage inputs, and pricing rules.
**Includes:** Pricing/rating logic, proration, discounts, charge calculation, producing a finalized "charge record" per billing period.
**Excludes:** Collecting usage data itself (1.4), rendering/formatting bills (1.3), storing/charging payment methods (1.2), any UI (1.5).
**Interfaces:** Consumes usage data from 1.4; produces charge records consumed by 1.3; triggers payment collection via 1.2.

### 1.2 Payment-Method Vault
**Definition:** Securely stores and manages customer payment methods and executes charge/payment transactions.
**Includes:** Tokenized storage of payment methods, add/update/remove payment method flows, transaction execution against a payment processor, transaction status tracking.
**Excludes:** Deciding *what amount* to charge (1.1 owns that), invoice formatting (1.3), displaying payment history to admins (1.5 reads it, doesn't own it).
**Interfaces:** Receives charge amounts from 1.1; reports transaction results back for invoicing/status.

### 1.3 Invoice Generator
**Definition:** Produces the customer-facing invoice document/record from a finalized charge.
**Includes:** Invoice numbering, line-item formatting, invoice status (draft/issued/paid), PDF/record generation, delivery (e.g., email) if in scope for this release.
**Excludes:** Calculating the charge amount (1.1), collecting payment (1.2), admin-facing views of invoices (1.5 displays, doesn't generate).
**Interfaces:** Consumes charge records from 1.1; reflects payment status from 1.2.

### 1.4 Usage-Tracking Service
**Definition:** Collects, aggregates, and stores usage metrics that feed billing calculations.
**Includes:** Usage event ingestion, aggregation by billing period, exposing aggregated usage data to the billing engine.
**Excludes:** Turning usage into a dollar amount (that's 1.1's job).
**Interfaces:** Feeds aggregated usage into 1.1.

### 1.5 Admin Dashboard
**Definition:** Internal, read-facing UI for viewing customer bills, invoices, and billing status.
**Includes:** Views/search for charges, invoices, payment status; read-only presentation layer.
**Excludes:** Any business logic for calculating charges, processing payments, or generating invoices — it only displays data owned by 1.1–1.4.
**Interfaces:** Reads from 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4; writes nothing back into billing logic.

---

## 100% Check
1.1 + 1.2 + 1.3 + 1.4 + 1.5 = full Team Billing scope for this release. No piece duplicates another's responsibility (each has a single owner for its function); multi-currency is explicitly carved out as a separate future scope, not silently absorbed into any of the five.

**Ready to assign** — each of the five (1.1–1.5) is a clean, ownable unit of work. Want me to add estimated sizing, suggested owners, or sequencing/dependencies next?
